description.en: DSH 插件：每天替你刷一轮 B站，读字幕挑出值得的、写一份日报，值得的 @ 你
原神哥伦比娅主题的 DeepSeek Harness Web 插件：背景、蒙版与明暗配色。A Genshin Impact Columbina themed plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web: background, mask, and per light/dark color schemes.
Standalone remote Web UI for DeepSeek Harness with mobile viewport, soft-keyboard and touch-target adaptations while leaving the native Desktop presentation unchanged.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 独立远程 Web UI：适配手机视口、软键盘与触控热区，同时保持原生桌面端界面不变。

description.en: Smart prompt optimization & dynamic thinking effort adaptation with composer capsule, DSH/custom models, undo/re-optimize, and native settings.
description.zh: 提示词智能优化与思考强度动态自适应插件，支持会话输入框胶囊控制条、DSH已配置/自定义第三方双模型来源、一键撤销与重新优化及原生配置面板。

description.en: Pack a directory into a deterministic tar, read an archive's contents without extracting it, unpack while refusing every member that could reach outside the destination, and verify what came out against what went in by SHA-256. No external dependency — the tar format is written and read in this plugin. Extraction is deliberately more permissive on reading than on writing, because a reader's job is to report what an archive says, while a writer must never emit what it cannot read back. A tar has no central index, so the walk tracks whether it reached the end-of-archive marker: without that, a half-file checksums fine and reads as complete.
description.zh: 把目录打成确定性 tar、不解包就列出内容、解包时逐个成员拒绝任何能写到目标目录之外的名字、并用 SHA-256 核对「解出来的东西 == 打进去的东西」。零外部依赖 —— tar 格式在这个插件里自己写、自己读。读比写更宽容是刻意的：读方的职责是如实报告归档说了什么，写方则绝不能写出自己读不回来的东西。tar 没有中央索引，所以遍历必须跟踪「有没有走到归档结束标记」—— 少了这一步，一个被截断的文件校验和照样正确、照样被读成完整。

description.en: Open a page, wait for it the way it actually needs, extract the readable article, and take a screenshot. Playwright is optional: when it is absent the tools fall back to a static fetch and say so in the result, because a page whose JavaScript never ran means something different from one that rendered. Content is chosen by scoring candidate subtrees on prose density rather than on tag names, so a container loses to the article inside it instead of winning by containing more of the document.
description.zh: 打开页面、按页面真正需要的方式等待、抽出可读正文、截图。Playwright 是可选依赖：没装时退回静态抓取并在结果里明确说明，因为「JavaScript 从未执行」的页面意味着的东西和渲染过的不同。正文靠给候选子树打正文密度分来选，而不是相信标签名，所以容器不会因为「包含的文档更多」而赢过它里面的正文。

description.en: Read, build and take apart EPUB 3 books with no external dependency — the ZIP reader/writer and the XML scanner are both built in. Inspect metadata, reading order and TOC for structural problems, assemble a book from chapters, or split one back into per-chapter HTML.
description.zh: 读、造、拆 EPUB 3 电子书，零外部依赖 —— ZIP 读写器与 XML 扫描器均为自建。可体检元数据/阅读顺序/目录并点出结构问题，从章节拼出一本合规的书，或把已有的书拆回逐章 HTML。

description.en: Turn a GitHub repository's raw counts into a defensible judgement — contributor concentration and bus factor with single-author files, merge time reported as a median beside the mean so an outlier is visible rather than hidden, and an issue backlog with pull requests and drafts filtered out. Reads the public REST API with no SDK, and never claims a truncated page is the whole answer.
description.zh: 把 GitHub 仓库的原始计数变成一句能站住的判断 —— 贡献者集中度与 bus factor（附单作者文件）、合并时长中位数与均值并列（让离群值可见而不是被隐藏）、以及排掉 PR 与 draft 之后的 issue backlog。只用公开 REST API、不装 SDK，分页被截断时明确说明而非伪装完整。

description.en: Convert Notion blocks and Markdown in both directions, with no API client and no external dependency. A Notion paragraph is an array of rich-text runs while Markdown says one string, so the two directions are a split and a merge rather than a pair of inverses — rich-text runs are cut at every annotation boundary one way and re-merged the other, with fences widened when the content already contains backticks. Reports every lossy step instead of swallowing it.
description.zh: Notion 区块与 Markdown 双向转换，不带 API 客户端、无外部依赖。Notion 的段落是一组富文本 run，而 Markdown 只有一个字符串 —— 所以两个方向分别是「切分」与「合并」，并不是一对互逆操作：一个方向在每个注解边界切开 run，另一个方向把相邻同注解的 run 重新合并，内容本身含反引号时自动加宽围栏。每一步有损转换都会报出来，而不是默默吞掉。

description.en: Turn a raw recording into a published podcast with a local ffmpeg — detect chapter boundaries from silence, cut at those boundaries, normalise loudness to a broadcast target in two passes, and write an iTunes-compatible RSS feed whose enclosure byte lengths are measured from disk.
description.zh: 用本机 ffmpeg 把一期录音做成可发布的播客 —— 从静音里检出章节断点、按断点切段、两遍算法把响度归一化到广播目标，并写出 iTunes 兼容的 RSS（enclosure 字节长度实测自磁盘，避免客户端静默丢弃）。

description.en: Read, audit and diff Protocol Buffer definitions without installing protoc: a zero-dependency .proto parser exposing six tools (status, outline, describe, diff, audit, next_number). diff classifies every change as breaking, risky or additive and names the wire-format consequence; audit catches what protoc accepts but a reviewer should not — duplicated or illegal field numbers, reserved-range collisions, unresolved types, and unreserved gaps below the high-water mark.
description.zh: 无需安装 protoc 即可阅读、审查和对比 Protocol Buffer 定义：零依赖 .proto 解析器，提供六个工具（status / outline / describe / diff / audit / next_number）。diff 会把每处改动分级为 breaking、risky、additive 并说明其线上格式后果；audit 能发现 protoc 接受但审查者不该放过的隐患——重复或非法字段编号、与 reserved 区间冲突、类型无法解析，以及高水位线以下未声明的空洞。

description.en: Generate QR codes from a from-scratch ISO/IEC 18004 encoder with no external tools, plan symbol version and error-correction headroom before producing anything, and decode an existing symbol back to text.
description.zh: 内置从零实现的 ISO/IEC 18004 编码器，无需任何外部程序即可出码；出图前先算清楚版本与纠错余量，也能把已有二维码读回文本。
